pages.title: Ant Moving Simulator
pages.creator: Rick&Jean
pages.description: Ant Moving Simulator turns pixel pictures into block-clearing puzzles. Move a front numbered box into an empty slot, and its ants automatically gather reachable blocks of the matching color. Clear the entire picture to finish. Linked boxes travel together, so you need enough free slots for the whole group. Power-ups can help when the available space makes the next move difficult.

pages.title: Slap Man
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Sprint through streets and slap passing characters in Slap Man. Slide left or right to steer around roadblocks and traps, then time your approach to land a slap on an NPC. Accurate movement and timing help you build a higher score. Use a mouse slide or drag a finger to control the runner.

pages.title: Underwater Survival
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Underwater Survival has you gather materials beneath the sea and use them to expand a safe zone. Break wrecked boats for wood, cut seaweed, and carry the resources back to the central area. Required materials open new areas and machines, including equipment for gathering more resources. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse as you explore and develop the underwater site.

pages.title: Car Out Jam
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Car Out Jam combines parking puzzles with a queue of color-matched passengers. Click a car to send it to a parking place; passengers at the front board only when their color matches the vehicle. A full car leaves, making room for the next one. Choose cars in an order that serves the queue, with sorting boosters and VIP parking available to help.

pages.title: Flow Block
pages.creator: Infinity Loop
pages.description: Flow Block mixes falling-block ideas with flowing sand. Select sand blocks from the bottom to place them in the play area, then build connections between particles of the same color. A connection spanning the left and right edges clears the matching sand and awards points, so the way the particles settle affects your next placement.

pages.title: Draw a path to the finish line!
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Draw a path to the finish line! asks you to sketch a route that guides a character from the start to the goal. Draw with the mouse or a finger, shaping the path around obstacles. Mines can restart the level if encountered, so the route must carry the character safely all the way to the finish.

pages.title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: The Road Home: Granny Escape is a horror escape game about searching for a way out while Granny and Grandpa hunt you. Collect objects and clues, solve puzzles, and open new areas without drawing their attention. Hide when they approach and stay quiet to avoid a chase. WASD moves the character, C crouches, and Space jumps.

pages.title: Count Masters Superhero
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Count Masters Superhero sends a superhero through running and jumping obstacle courses. Keep moving through the level while avoiding hazards such as rotating maces and cutting machines. Use mouse clicks or taps to play and guide the character past the dangers along the route.

pages.title: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving is a car simulator focused on stunt driving. Use WASD to control the vehicle and take on the game's driving challenges, working on your handling through its stunt courses.

pages.title: Maze Escape Toilet Rush
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Maze Escape Toilet Rush puts an urgent destination at the end of each labyrinth: the toilet. Find a route through each new maze and get the character to the destination quickly. Use mouse clicks or taps to play while working out which passages lead to the goal.

pages.title: Super Stock Stack
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Super Stock Stack asks you to organize food cans on shelves by matching their labels. Sort the incoming stock and keep its arrangement under control as the levels grow harder. Use a mouse or touchpad to manage the cans and bring matching products together.

pages.title: Connect Balls New Year Puzzles!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Connect Balls New Year Puzzles! has you drop matching balls into a growing pile and combine them into larger versions. Hold the mouse or a finger to position a ball, then release to drop it. Work toward the largest ball, which disappears for the biggest points reward. Keep space available: filling a line of the field restarts the game.

pages.title: Merge Town!
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Merge Town! starts with a plot of land and a stream of houses to place on it. Combine houses of the same type to create larger homes, gradually turning the plot into a growing town. New houses arrive over time, giving you more buildings to merge as the settlement develops.

pages.title: Bridge Fight!
pages.creator: A Coast Game
pages.description: Build crossings for a monster army in Bridge Fight! Tap to stack bricks into a bridge wide enough for the group to cross safely. Guide the monsters toward enemy forces, moving around the battlefield and avoiding the boss. The bridge you construct determines how your army gets across to the fight.

pages.title: Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends lets you prepare celebrities for the spring season. Browse their wardrobes, choose outfits and costumes, and put together looks inspired by spring fashions. Use the left mouse button or tap to make your selections.

pages.title: King Kong Kart Racing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: King Kong Kart Racing sends you along cartoon tracks against rival karts. Overtake other racers, ride the speed lanes, and gather fuel packs to keep your run going longer. Managing the route means finding opportunities to pass while staying supplied with fuel.

pages.title: Find the Differences Cars
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find the Differences Cars challenges you to locate seven changes between two car pictures. Search the images and click or tap the details that differ before the time limit expires. The game contains twenty levels and limits incorrect selections, so careful inspection matters as well as speed.

pages.title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
pages.creator: No
pages.description: Stickman Ragdoll Playground is a physics game about sending a stickman into destructive falls. Select a level, hold the Play button, and release at the right moment to launch the character harder. Falls earn points and money that can unlock skins, vehicles, and additional levels. The character's ragdoll reactions turn each landing into part of the challenge.

pages.title: Winter Tiles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Winter Tiles is a timed connection puzzle with winter pictures. Select two identical tiles that can be joined by a clear path with at most two turns. Remove every pair from the board before the timer expires to open the next level. Use the mouse or touchpad to choose tiles.

pages.title: Dig In Mine
pages.creator: Orosula Games
pages.description: Dig In Mine puts you in control of a jackhammer digging into an underground world. Hold and drag with the mouse or a finger to guide the mining journey, collecting gold as you descend. The game continues without a fixed endpoint, and the gold you gather can unlock different appearances.

pages.title: High School Dress Up For Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: High School Dress Up For Girls lets you create school looks from a wardrobe of shirts, skirts, tunics, and accessories. Change an outfit with mouse clicks, then coordinate it with items such as glasses, belts, or bags. Mix the available pieces to give the students their own styles.

pages.title: Stylish Tiered Ruffle Addiction
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Stylish Tiered Ruffle Addiction follows a group of friends preparing for a fashion meeting with a ruffle theme. Help each girl put together a look that suits the shared idea. Use the left mouse button or tap to make selections for the group's outfits.

pages.title: Super Steve Adventure
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Super Steve Adventure combines platform courses with monster battles. Move Steve through each stage, jump across the route, and attack enemies while collecting gold and stars. Spend the gold in the shop to develop or customize the character. A and D move, W jumps, and Space attacks; arrow keys and touch controls are also available for movement.

pages.title: Animals Memory Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Animals Memory Match asks you to remember the animal pictures hidden on cards. Reveal cards and locate their matching partners, clearing the whole board to complete a level. There are twenty-four levels to solve, with mouse or touchpad controls for selecting the cards.

pages.title: X2 Block Match
pages.creator: Stonemobile Kft
pages.description: X2 Block Match is a number-merging puzzle with a goal of reaching 2048. Tap a column and combine blocks with matching values to produce larger numbers. Keep planning where the next merge can happen as the combinations become harder to arrange, while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Bus Driver Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Bus Driver Simulator offers tourist transport and bus racing as separate ways to play. Pick up passengers and carry them to destinations along mountain and forest routes, or compete against other buses for a race win. On a computer, drive with WASD and change the camera with C; touch buttons provide the driving controls on mobile.

pages.title: Hidden Birds
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hidden Birds turns forest scenes into hidden-object puzzles. Search each picture for birds concealed among the surroundings and select them with the mouse or touchpad. Find all the birds and complete eight levels to finish the game.

pages.title: Candy Chain Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Candy Chain Match challenges you to remove the nets covering a board of sweets. Connect at least three matching items through neighboring horizontal, vertical, or diagonal positions. Each chain frees the affected blocks from their nets. Clear every net to finish a stage, working through thirty-six levels with mouse or touchpad controls.

pages.title: Paint Roll 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Paint Roll 3D is a coloring puzzle in which the order of painting matters. Follow the supplied pattern and apply its colors in the required sequence to reproduce the design. Tap to play and work out which part of the pattern must be painted first.

pages.title: Underwater Car Racing Simulator
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Underwater Car Racing Simulator places car racing on slippery underwater tracks. Slide to steer and keep the vehicle on the course as you work through its different routes. Careless movement can send the car off the track, making controlled handling part of the racing challenge.

pages.title: Stick War Adventure
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Stick War Adventure sends an armed stickman into battles with increasingly strong enemies. Collect dropped items and gold, then visit the Upgrade section between levels to improve the character's strength and activate special attacks. Bosses appear in later chapters. Arrow keys handle movement and jumping, V punches, and D, S, Z, X, and C trigger special attacks.

pages.title: Reach the Core
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Guide a mining machine into a planet in Reach the Core. Two robots need plasma from its core after their spacecraft runs out of energy. Steer the drill toward that objective with the arrow keys or WASD, or use the built-in joystick on a touch device.

pages.title: Pixel Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pixel Memory is a card-matching puzzle about remembering pictures and their positions. Reveal cards, find their matching partners, and remove every pair to clear the level. Use mouse clicks or taps to select the cards.

pages.title: Just Color!
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Just Color! asks you to reproduce the color shown in a reference picture. Adjust the sliders to change an object's shade, then keep refining it until it matches the example. Each level presents another object and color to recreate.

pages.title: Word Finding Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Silly Game Studio
pages.description: Word Finding Puzzle Game hides words inside a letter grid. Swipe along letters to select an answer, searching horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Words can run forward or backward in any of eight directions. Find every hidden word to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Slenderman Must Die: Underground Bunker 2021
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search an underground military bunker for evidence in Slenderman Must Die: Underground Bunker 2021. Find eight pieces of information while fighting Slenderman and his companions, uncovering the military's deal with him. Use WASD to move, the mouse to look and shoot, R to reload, and F to pick up items as you explore the bunker.

pages.title: Construction Set
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Construction Set turns boxes of building pieces into three-dimensional assembly puzzles. Choose a set, unpack it, and follow the instructions to join the parts into the finished model. Projects include vehicles and houses, with each assembly built from the small pieces provided. Click to play and work through the construction steps.

pages.title: Food Roll
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Food Roll puts you in control of a ball that consumes blocks from a patterned course. Roll toward the pieces to swallow them while staying away from the large mouth hunting you. Completing more of these challenges unlocks additional items, giving you new rewards as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Run Royale Knockout
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run Royale Knockout is an obstacle-course race against rival runners. Navigate the course's hazards and get past the other competitors as you aim to win the round. Click and drag the mouse to guide your character through the obstacles.

pages.title: Among Them Space Rush
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Among Them Space Rush is a fast running game with obstacles and a one-minute limit for finishing each level. Guide the character along the route, collecting speed and time bonuses while racing other runners. Use the arrow keys or tap to play and reach the finish before the clock expires.

pages.title: Nifty Hoopers
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Nifty Hoopers turns basketball shots into a timing challenge. Choose a nation and score enough points before the timer ends. Click when the pointer reaches the green zone for an accurate shot. A defender must be confused first by clicking in the blue zone, giving you a short opening to shoot before the opponent recovers.

pages.title: Santa Gift Delivery
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Santa Gift Delivery asks you to route sleighs toward houses that match the color of their gifts. Tap the arrow buttons to change directions and guide each delivery to the right home. Sleighs arrive closer together and move faster as you progress. Aim for a high score before making three incorrect deliveries.

pages.title: Tiny Archer
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tiny Archer challenges you to hit a continuing series of targets. Time the arrow's release to aim for the center and keep progressing. Misses cost arrows from a limited supply, so each inaccurate shot shortens your attempt. Reaching farther targets can unlock additional skins as you try to improve your record.

pages.title: Quick Color Tap
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Quick Color Tap begins with sixteen squares in four colors. Watch the brief background flash, then select a square of the same color to remove it. A wrong color ends the attempt. Clear the whole board and try to reduce the time taken, balancing quick reactions with accurate color recognition.

pages.title: Chameleon Want Eat
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Chameleon Want Eat has you feed a color-changing chameleon with insects. Tap to rotate the animal toward its food and match its current color to the insects it can eat. Keep checking the chameleon's shade as you turn it for the next meal.

pages.title: Animals Jumble
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Animals Jumble combines scrambled words with animal pictures. Rearrange the letters mentally to identify an animal's name, then select its picture on the screen. Each level contains five jumbled names to solve, and the game has ten levels. Use the mouse or touch controls to choose your answers.

pages.title: Cute Owl Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Cute Owl Memory asks you to find pairs of owl pictures hidden on cards. Tap to reveal a card, remember its image and position, and locate its matching partner. Work within the time limit as you search the board for every pair.

pages.title: Kill the Zombies
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Kill the Zombies puts a fighter between undead attackers approaching from both sides. Use a pistol and fists to repel the advancing enemies. Arrow keys move the character, Space fires, and R reloads, letting you reposition and keep fighting as the zombies close in.

pages.title: Princess Coloring Game
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Princess Coloring Game offers mermaid pictures to paint and decorate. Choose from its coloring pages and use mouse clicks or taps to apply your colors, creating your own look for the ocean princesses.

pages.title: Brownies
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Brownies is a cooking game about preparing a batch of chocolate brownies. Follow the on-screen instructions to work with the kitchen ingredients and utensils, mix the batter, and bake the dessert. The guided activities take you through making the treats in the game's kitchen.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Dining Manners
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Dining Manners follows Hazel as she learns how to behave at the dining table. Help her through the lesson and interact with Hazel and her mother using the mouse, guiding the child through the game's dining activities.

pages.title: Falling Down
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Falling Down has you guide a small blue bird toward the ground through a field of obstacles. The bird carries a parachute that slows its descent, giving it more time to dodge hazards. Use the mouse to play and help the bird reach the bottom safely.

pages.title: Aero Coloring Books
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Aero Coloring Books provides pictures of aircraft to color. Paint vehicles such as airplanes, helicopters, and seaplanes, choosing how each picture should look. Use the mouse to work on the drawings.

pages.title: 1010 No Danger
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: 1010 No Danger is a block-placement puzzle with marked danger blocks to remove. Drag groups from the left panel into empty spaces, completing a row or column that contains a marked block to clear it. Eliminate every danger sign while keeping enough room on the board for the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Hexa Merge
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Hexa Merge combines numbered-block merging with a hexagonal board. Drag blocks onto empty tiles and arrange matching pieces so they combine into higher-value blocks. Tap to swap the available blocks, planning each placement as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Avoid
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Avoid follows your mouse pointer through a field of obstacles and enemies. Move the pointer to steer the player away from incoming hazards while gathering points. Staying clear of everything thrown into your path is the main challenge as you keep moving through the action.

pages.title: Piggy soldier super adventure
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Piggy soldier super adventure is a two-dimensional shooting game with multiple levels and enemy encounters. Move with the arrow keys, jump with Space, and fire with F as you guide the pig soldier through the stages and fight the opponents along the way.

pages.title: American Modern Bus Parking : Bus Game Simulator 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: American Modern Bus Parking : Bus Game Simulator 2020 puts you behind the wheel of a bus for parking challenges. Maneuver through the driving areas and position the large vehicle in parking zones, working through the game's bus-driving tasks.

pages.title: Warfare Area
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Warfare Area casts you as the last soldier remaining in a captured base. Take up a rifle and fight the enemies occupying it. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use the mouse to turn, aim, and shoot. Touch controls provide a movement joystick, a fire button, and a separate area for looking around.

pages.title: Alien Slide
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Alien Slide is a survival score challenge with moving obstacles. Click or tap to switch the character's movement and keep it clear of the incoming hazards. Your score grows while you remain alive, but colliding with an obstacle ends the attempt.

pages.title: Car Highway Racing 2019 : Car Racing Simulator
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Car Highway Racing 2019 : Car Racing Simulator is an endless highway-driving game with a choice of cars. Customize the vehicle's color and tires, then improve its acceleration and brakes. Different ways to race include Endless, Two-Way, and Time Trial modes, letting you tackle the highway under different conditions.

pages.title: Sea Animal Cargo Truck
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Sea Animal Cargo Truck is a truck-driving game with multiple levels to complete. Use WASD to control the vehicle and press C to change the camera, adjusting your view as you drive through the game's challenges.

pages.title: Listen Music Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Listen Music Jigsaw provides twelve pictures to reconstruct from puzzle pieces. Select an image and choose Easy with 25 pieces, Medium with 49, or Hard with 100. Move the pieces into place with the mouse or touch controls until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Taxi Simulator 2019
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Taxi Simulator 2019 puts you in a yellow cab competing with other drivers for customers. Navigate crowded city roads, reach destinations within the time limit, and contend with other vehicles and limited parking space. Drive with WASD and use Escape to pause while working through the taxi challenges.

pages.title: Hogie The Globehoppper Adventure Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hogie The Globehoppper Adventure Puzzle asks you to build a route with movable blocks. Drag pieces into position so Hogie can cross the scene and collect three stars and a banana to finish the level. The puzzles take him through places including Bangkok, Barcelona, Cairo, and Machu Picchu.

pages.title: cars vs cops
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: cars vs cops is an endless driving chase in which nearby police cars create opportunities for combo scoring. Steer with the mouse or touch controls and maneuver while letting pursuing cops approach closely enough to activate combos. Keep the chase going as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Pixie Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Pixie Pregnant Check Up is a doctor game about examining an expectant fairy. Use the hospital's medical tools, give Pixie her in-game vitamins, and finish the visit by choosing a color for a belly tattoo. Tap to interact with the checkup activities.

pages.title: Tuk Tuk Crazy Driver
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tuk Tuk Crazy Driver sends you through a city overrun by zombies. Drive the tuk-tuk into the undead while avoiding street obstacles, using bonus items to boost the vehicle. Move quickly through the roads and help stop the creatures invading the town.

pages.title: Drawing and Coloring
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drawing and Coloring offers several animals to draw using a selection of drawing tools. Choose a subject and work on its picture, using the available tools to create your version of the animal.

pages.title: Nighty Knight
pages.creator: Froton
pages.description: Nighty Knight is an action game about fighting repeated waves of V.E.R.M.I.N. Choose to play as the Nighty Knight or Pew Pew Princess, then take on one group of enemies after another.

pages.title: Design My Kendama
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design My Kendama follows a princess preparing for her first kendama contest. Help her personalize three different kendama designs and practice for the event. The contest calls for a custom toy, making its appearance part of her preparation.

pages.title: Logical Theatre Tower of Hanoi
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Logical Theatre Tower of Hanoi presents the classic ring-transfer puzzle. Rearrange a stack of different-sized rings between the towers, planning the order of the moves to rebuild the tower and solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Italia Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Italia Jigsaw Puzzle offers picture puzzles in Easy, Medium, and Hard modes. Choose a difficulty and fit the pieces together to reconstruct the image. There is no time limit, so you can work through each arrangement at your own pace.

pages.title: Fruit Master
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Fruit Master challenges you to slice fruit and turn it into a completed cocktail. Cut several fruits in combinations to earn extra points, then finish the drink to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Stickman sniper Tap to kill
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Stickman sniper Tap to kill casts you as a secret agent with a sniper rifle and a set of precise orders. Read the target's identity at the beginning of each level, then find and shoot the correct person. Complete the assigned missions by concentrating on the target information.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Mommy Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Princess Mermaid Mommy Birth follows a mermaid princess through labor and the arrival of her baby. In the game's emergency sequence, call for an ambulance and help keep her comfortable until it arrives. Continue at the hospital with activities caring for the princess and her newborn. Tap to interact throughout the story.

pages.title: Girls Pool Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Pool Party lets you dress princesses for a special poolside gathering. Help them choose outfits that suit the party's setting and put together the looks they will wear to the event.

pages.title: SOCCER 2018 FACE ART
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: SOCCER 2018 FACE ART lets you prepare Elsa to support a football team. Choose from four countries, apply suitable makeup, and create face art for the selected side. The preparation also includes a search for the ball before the team's supporter look is finished.

pages.title: Boys Cooking Challenge
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Boys Cooking Challenge is a cake-making contest featuring princes. Pick the prince you want to help, then prepare his cake for the cooking challenge. Work on the dessert as you take part in the summer contest.

pages.title: Tap & Clapp
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Tap & Clapp is a physics puzzle about changing characters between square and round forms. Click a character to switch its shape and alter how it moves across the stage. Guide the hero into the finish area, using the transformations to work around the level's arrangement of platforms and mechanisms.

pages.title: Ice Queen Resurrection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Queen Resurrection Emergency puts you in charge of a fictional emergency-room treatment. Use the game's oxygen mask and resuscitation activities to help the Ice Queen recover, then continue with an IV and vitamins. Tap to interact with the medical tools and work through her care.

pages.title: Differences Butterflies
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Differences Butterflies asks you to find seven changes in each butterfly scene. Examine the pictures and select the details that do not match. There are five levels, with fifteen stars available across the game.

pages.title: Clown Girl and Friends
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Clown Girl and Friends lets you style Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy, and Catwoman for Halloween. Choose outfits, arrange hair, apply makeup, and add accessories for each character. Their wardrobes offer different themes, from Poison Ivy's green clothing to Catwoman's dark and animal-print pieces. Use mouse clicks or a finger to assemble the three looks.

pages.title: BombEm
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: BombEm is an action game in which you blow up your opponents to win each match.

pages.title: Mahjong Solitaire Deluxe
pages.creator: Mediagamez
pages.description: Mahjong Solitaire Deluxe challenges you to empty layouts of stacked tiles. Select matching pairs that are not blocked and remove them from the board. Completing matches within the bonus time earns additional points. Choose a layout and keep finding available pairs until the arrangement is cleared.

pages.title: State The Rate
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: State The Rate tests your timing with a moving progress bar. Click or tap to stop it at the right moment, judging when to make your selection as the bar advances.

pages.title: Loch Ness Water Skiing
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Loch Ness Water Skiing offers a retro ride on pixel-style water skis. Control the skier with the mouse or directional keys and look out for a glimpse of the legendary monster along the way.

pages.title: Berry Cheesecake: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Berry Cheesecake: Sara's Cooking Class brings you into Sara's kitchen for a dessert lesson. Help her prepare a berry cheesecake, using the mouse to work through the cooking activities as she teaches the recipe.

pages.title: Candy Perfect Make Up
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Candy Perfect Make Up combines a cosmetics makeover with hair and outfit choices. Select foundation, eyeshadow, blush, lipstick, eyelashes, and eyebrows to build the makeup look. Arrange the hairstyle, then add a dress and accessories to complete the girl's appearance.

pages.title: Laps
pages.creator: Funmoth Games
pages.description: Laps is a score challenge controlled through combinations of clicks. Use different click patterns to adjust the game's bars as you play, aiming to raise your score with each attempt.
